description: Missing-preposition repair for 'go school' -> 'go to school' (audit commit ad3641395). This is one sub-pattern of rule en-step5-preposition-pattern, which inserts the missing 'to' after go/goes/went/going + school. Expectations encode the VERIFIED behaviour of correctWithTutorRules() on current main; the asserted rule id is en-step5-preposition-pattern (the rule that owns this sub-pattern).
fp_risk_note: The 'to' insertion must fire only when it is genuinely missing. The negative cases stress already-correct phrasings that must NOT be re-touched: 'go to school' (preposition already present — a regression that matches 'go ... school' too loosely would double it to 'go to to school'), an infinitive 'want to go to school', and third-person 'goes to school'. Note: en-step5-preposition-pattern also owns unrelated sub-patterns (depend of->on, interested with->in, good in->at, listen music->to); this fixture scopes positives/negatives to the go-to-school surface only.
